title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.18947v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Production LLM agents increasingly depend on real-time search, yet native search grounding bundles retrieval policy, provider choice, evidence injection, cost, latency, and generation behavior behind a single model-provider boundary. This coupling makes grounding hard to inspect, tune, reuse, or port, and can trigger Search-Induced Verbosity that breaks strict output contracts. We present Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG), a vendor-agnostic boundary that moves grounding outside the reasoning model through an MCP-compatible gateway, exposing provider routing, source-aware context rendering, configured fallback, retrieval-depth control, and exact plus semantic caching as first-class controls. Across five frontier models on SimpleQA, FreshQA, and HotpotQA, native search leads on recency-sensitive FreshQA, but DSG exposes a stronger frontier when control matters: on SimpleQA it nearly matches native accuracy (86.1% vs. 87.7%) at 91% lower

translated_title: 解耦搜索与推理：面向大语言模型智能体的供应商无关接地架构
translated_abstract: 生产环境中的大语言模型智能体日益依赖实时搜索，然而原生的搜索接地方式将检索策略、供应商选择、证据注入、成本、延迟和生成行为捆绑在单一模型供应商边界之后。这种耦合使得接地过程难以检查、调优、复用或移植，并可能引发“搜索诱导冗余”（Search-Induced Verbosity），破坏严格的输出契约。我们提出了去耦合搜索接地（DSG），这是一种供应商无关的边界，通过兼容MCP的网关将接地过程移至推理模型之外，将供应商路由、基于来源的上下文渲染、可配置回退、检索深度控制以及精确加语义缓存作为一等控制项。在SimpleQA、FreshQA和HotpotQA三个基准上对五个前沿模型的评估显示，原生搜索在对时效性敏感的FreshQA上领先，但当控制性至关重要时，DSG展现了更强的前沿表现：在SimpleQA上，DSG在成本降低91%的情况下几乎达到与原生搜索相当的准确率（86.1% vs. 87.7%）。
tldr: 提出去耦合搜索接地（DSG）架构，通过供应商无关的MCP网关将实时搜索从推理模型中解耦出来，在成本降低91%的同时实现接近原生搜索的准确率，并解决了搜索诱导冗余问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG), a vendor-agnostic architecture that separates real-time search from LLM reasoning via an MCP-compatible gateway, achieving near-native accuracy with 91% lower cost while solving search-induced verbosity issues.
